entities.summary: Franciszek Paweł Raszeja was a Polish orthopaedic physician and academic teacher. The brother of activist Leon Raszeja, he was killed while visiting a Jewish patient in the Warsaw Ghetto during World War II.

entities.summary: Franciszek Paweł Raszeja was a Polish orthopaedic physician and academic teacher. The brother of activist Leon Raszeja, he was killed while visiting a Jewish patient in the Warsaw Ghetto during World War II.
